# vendor/ — third-party library files (not our code)

- `tailwindcss-play-3.4.17.js` — Tailwind CSS Play build (MIT licence), downloaded from cdn.tailwindcss.com
  so the page works without venue Wi-Fi. In B0, copy it into `static/` and load it with
  `<script src="tailwindcss-play-3.4.17.js"></script>`.
